remarks: True ski-in, ski-out living in an unbeatable location with direct skiing to the Main Holimont Lodge! Enjoy the very best of Holimont and the charming village of Ellicottville from this exceptional chalet, perfectly positioned to take advantage of the slopes, spectacular views, and year-round recreation. Designed for gathering and entertaining, the spacious open-concept living area features a generous kitchen with new stainless steel appliances and plenty of room for multiple cooks and guests. An oversized granite island provides abundant prep space and seating, while a formal dining area offers even more room to gather. At the heart of the home is the impressive fireplace with beautiful stone from the local Ellicottville Quarry, creating a warm and inviting focal point with beautiful views overlooking Holimont. After a day on the slopes, there’s no better place to relax and unwind. The convenient first-floor primary suite offers a private bath and walk-in closet. Upstairs, two large bedrooms and an additional full bath provide comfortable accommodations for family and guests. Enjoy the back deck with TV, built in firepit and hot tub, or the front deck providing exceptional views. The home has a full basement which is a rare find in the Holimont development. Additional convenience is offered with an outdoor ski locker. Whether you're looking for the ultimate ski retreat or a four-season getaway, this chalet delivers an exceptional combination of location, views, space, and true ski-in, ski-out convenience. A rare opportunity to enjoy everything Holimont and Ellicottville have to offer right outside your door! Furnishings are negotiable.
